title: Beautiful no pressure habit app
body:
Avocation is a really pretty app to look at, which I love! I also like the no pressure approach. I’m not competing to get “streaks” in, just finding things that make my life nicer and reminding myself to do them and growing a sweet little plant in the process, I hope the plant doesn’t die if I get behind on my habits...

The lessons on habit forming and the neuroscience behind them is great! They are making the app and habit practice as brain friendly as possible, which can only lead to better success for all of us using the app.

I also appreciated the buy it once/lifetime access feature, which I greatly prefer over an annual subscription.
